UAE intercepts Iranian drone; Iran claims US drone downing

The United Arab Emirates announced it intercepted an Iranian drone flying over its territorial waters. Iran, meanwhile, claimed it shot down a US MQ-9 drone over the Strait of Hormuz. The UAE denied Iran's claim of striking the Al Minhad airbase. The incidents occur amidst heightened regional tensions.
